_about: Polestar's public quest mechanics: how a quest is done beyond its objectives, in our own words, ids and positions. `forge data build --kb` merges it over the private mechanics layers by their rules, into data/forever/mechanics.json. quests: { "<quest id>": { kinds, params, steps, note } }. kinds: [{ kind, confidence }]: kind is one of escort, timed, summon-by-item, use-item-at-place, use-item-on-mob, object-click, vendor-buy, crafted, event-start, group/elite, item-from-other-quest, multi-step-in-one-objective, delayed-offer, other; confidence high, medium (default) or low. A kind gains the source `public`; it drives the route when it is high or another source agrees with it; a kind the server data refutes is not added. params: [{ kind, ... }]: the kind's parameters (for example delayed-offer: after, npc, sec; summon-by-item: item, npc); they join a kind some layer keeps, replacing the row with the same kind and item. steps: [{ n, action, target, item, count, place, fact, confidence }]: step n replaces the step with that n or is added; place is { map, x, y, f } (uiMapID, map percent, f `e` for the Classic frame). note: where each fact comes from (an in-game check, a recording, a player report with its issue number, the game's data). Check an edit with `forge data check-corrections`. See docs/forge/data.md, Changing the data. Hand-checked mechanics fixes, applied over every layer and always driving the route, live in forever-db/corrections/mechanics.json.

steps.fact: Kill Tideress in Mystral Lake with Stonetalon Standstill (25) in your log or handed in: only then does she drop the Befouled Water Globe that starts the quest.

1918.note: The Befouled Element (1918) starts from the Befouled Water Globe (16408), which Tideress (12759) drops only for a player who has Stonetalon Standstill (25) in the log or handed in. Source: players' in-game recordings to 2026-11-08: the 7 people who took 1918 all had 25 (6 in the log, 1 handed in), 2 people without it killed Tideress and got no globe, and the player report #1346. The loot tables of the Classic servers have only a Horde condition on the globe.

steps.fact: Get four Shiny Red Apples: Homer Stonefield sells them, and Elwynn's kobolds and crates drop them too.

Click the Applejack Still north of the Westbrook Garrison with the four apples in your bags: it takes them and gives you a Thunder Applejack on the spot. The quest has no accept and never shows in your quest log.

91736.note: The Applejack Still (91736) is handed in at the still (object 562131) the moment it is clicked with four Shiny Red Apples (4536), and gives the Thunder Applejack (247824). Source: Players' in-game recordings since launch (4 hand-ins of 91736 at the still, no accept and no quest window; a player who drank the Thunder Applejack was shown only Sergeant De Vries's shop) and the player reports #820 and #823.

steps.fact: Sergeant De Vries has An Apple Treat only while you carry the Thunder Applejack from the Applejack Still. Without it he opens only his shop; with it, talking to him goes straight to the hand-in.

91738.note: An Apple Treat (91738) is offered by Sergeant De Vries (npc 955) only while the player carries the Thunder Applejack (247824) from The Applejack Still (91736); there is no accept window. Source: Players' in-game recordings since launch (4 hand-ins of 91736 at the still, no accept and no quest window; a player who drank the Thunder Applejack was shown only Sergeant De Vries's shop) and the player reports #820 and #823.

steps.fact: Dorius Stonetender at the Grimesilt Dig Site gives the quest, and the escort starts as soon as you take it.
Keep Dorius alive while he walks north-east to Dustfire Valley.
When it is over, read the Singed Letter he leaves on the road.

3367.note: Suntara Stones (3367) is an escort: Forever's quest data lists its one objective as the Dorius Escort event, ending at the Singed Letter (object 175704) in Dustfire Valley, and the server data marks it an escort. Taken and left behind, it fails, so the route takes it right before the walk.
